coverage.method: AI-assisted editorial review of every AZ/EN primary definition and POS, followed by per-row comparison against supplied dictionary evidence where available. Not professional lexicographic certification.
coverage.source_note: Primary source-comparison applies to the 4,030 listed words. Primary dictionary records were read for every available row; print fallbacks were compared, with selected full entries examined. Secondary displayed-sense coverage is separately recorded below; exhaustive review of every unshown source sense is not claimed.
coverage.secondary_senses_note: All 1,674 displayed secondary pairs in 978 entries assessed. 448 pairs were rewritten, removed as metadata/misclassification, or recast within corrected lexical entries. Existing valid wording may remain terse; all external dictionary senses beyond the displayed pairs are outside this secondary pass.
coverage.indirect_reference_note: Thirty previously uncited proposals now carry actually inspected print, explicit synonym/derived-term or dictionary citations. These indirect references do not imply independently verified headword entries. One unsupported/slang conflict was moved to holds.
coverage.secondary_sense_policy: Every user-visible secondary pair in otherSenses.slice(1) was explicitly read in AZ and EN with the available dictionary glosses. The 975 supplied headword records were compared using English senses where available or a selected other-edition record; the three missing headword records were compared using print or explicit historical sources. Concise original paraphrases correct homograph translation errors, grammatical labels, agency, register and context. Valid polysemy and seven previously corrected complete sense sets are preserved. Source agreement is not independent expert verification; one precise botanical identification is held. No professional lexicographic certification is claimed.
